name: Android Maid no Nanami-san wa Gohoushi Daisuki de Goshujin-sama wa Sugu ni Icchau no.
original_name: アンドロイドメイドのナナミさんはご奉仕大好きでご主人様はすぐにイっちゃうの。
source:
One day, the main character purchases an android robot. "Well, I hope it comes soon...." Finally, his maid android robot arrives...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081024012546/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_46/products_id/1010041]Eroge Shop[/url]]
